$comment: Task class -> tier, effort, isolation. The chair tags every spawn prompt's FIRST line `Class: <name>`; the route guard (scripts/ledger_guard_spawn.py) reads the tag and denies a spawn whose model sits below the class's tier, or whose class is `chair-only`. Classes marked `min_tier` accept that tier or any tier above it in `order`. Override per machine at ~/.claude/orchestrator/routing.json.

scan.about: grep, glob, fetch-to-disk, list, count. Batch five lookups into one worker. Cheap tier only: a scan on a dearer tier is the waste this class exists to stop.

research.about: read a source a scout already fetched to scratch (or fetch it verbatim first), return a brief with quotes and confidence.

implement.about: code to a spec that cites ledger items; tests; refactors.

review.about: standard code review against the ledger. Not security.

hard.about: architecture, irreversible migrations, multi-system change, stubborn debugging, and any bulk-tier `uncertain` escalation.

security.about: ALL security review. Never below heavy, never on the chair.

verify.about: fresh-eyes verification of a close. Must not have built the work. Writes the verdict file. Runs on bulk by default; pass the heavy model for security, irreversible or architecture closes.

chair-only.about: arbitration, escalation ceiling. Not delegable; a spawn tagged this is denied.
